additional_info.subject: Note to ES Team
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
NA
Problem Description:
The Power convertor E34 error was logged once in the past month, but there are no active error flags now. RC wants to update the charger to v6.0.3. We attempted the update from SCB, from v2.11 to v3.2.8, but it is not updating.
Action Performed (L2):
We attempted to update the charger to v3.2.8 twice, but both attempts failed. RC has confirmed via Teams chat that if possible, the charger should be updated to v6.0.3.
Charger SW Version:
v2.11
Reason for Handover (L3):
Further investigation of the firmware update is required. If feasible, update FW via SSH.
Fault history:
Power Converter E34 error was logged once on 29th January, as I checked for the last 4 weeks.
Log analysis with timestamp:
2025-01-29T12:15:16.716Z of Power convertor Error
